source: NASA/JPL SBDB Query API (ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb_query.api), osculating heliocentric ecliptic J2000 elements
selection: all NUMBERED asteroids of SBDB orbit classes MBA (2.0 < a < 3.2 AU) and OMB (3.2 < a < 4.6 AU) with absolute magnitude H < 13.5; (1) Ceres, (2) Pallas, (4) Vesta and (10) Hygiea are excluded here because they are individual catalogue objects
